input.prompt:
Cinematic film still, 16:9, night. Medium close-up portrait of one woman standing alone under a covered railway station canopy in light rain. She stands in the left-of-centre third of the frame, framed from mid-chest up, her body angled toward camera-right and her head turned about forty-five degrees away from the lens in a three-quarter profile — her brow, cheekbone, nose line, jaw and one eye are clearly readable, and her gaze rests on something off frame to the right. Her expression is quiet, inward and unsmiling, lips closed. She is in her early thirties, with shoulder-length dark hair, damp, a few strands stuck to her temple and cheek, and she wears a dark charcoal wool overcoat with the collar turned up, plain and unbranded, slightly oversized. Her hands are out of frame. Fine rain has beaded on her shoulders and in her hair.

Behind her, out of focus on the far track, a train is passing left to right: its lit windows and body panels smear into long horizontal motion-blur streaks of warm and cool light. The concrete platform is wet and reflective, holding smeared reflections of the overhead lamps and the train windows in shallow standing water. A dark cast-iron canopy column and an overhead beam sit deep in the background for depth. Fine rain streaks are visible outside the canopy line where they catch the backlight.

Lighting: low-key, practical-motivated night lighting. A warm sodium platform lamp above and behind camera-right rakes across her face at a three-quarter angle, modelling the cheekbone and leaving the far side of her face in soft open shadow. Cool white light from the canopy fluorescents and the moving train's windows puts a cold rim along her hair, shoulder and coat collar, separating her from the background. Very low warm bounce comes up off the wet platform. Deep but open shadows, subtle contrast, no crushed blacks.

Lens: 85mm at f/1.4, eye level, shallow depth of field with the focus plane on her eyes; the platform, canopy column and passing train fall progressively soft behind her.

Texture and skin: real photographic skin with visible pores, faint under-eye shadow, slight moisture on the skin, no retouching, no glamour smoothing. Natural wool weave in the coat. Believable human anatomy and proportions.

Style: photorealistic cinematic photography, desaturated sodium-and-teal night grade, mild halation on the practical lamps, fine natural film grain. Intimate, urban, quietly melancholic.

Negative: no other people, no text, no signage, no destination boards, no timetables, no logos, no train livery lettering, no watermark, no subtitles, no umbrella, no phone, no luggage, no heavy rain or storm, no smiling, no direct eye contact with the lens, no extra or deformed hands, no plastic or airbrushed skin, no neon cyberpunk grade, no lens flare, no illustration or 3D render look.
